screens.name: Project list with filters

empty.copy: No projects match these filters. [Clear filters]
empty.behavior: EmptyState with a secondary Button that resets status to all and clears the search

loading.behavior: existing Spinner; filters disabled until the list arrives

error.behavior: existing Alert tone danger; filters hidden

success.behavior: list filtered as the user types; count updates

partial.not_applicable: the list loads in one response; there is no paging

permission-denied.not_applicable: every signed-in user may see the project list

keyboard: Tab order: search, status select, results; Escape in the search clears it; focus ring --color-focus
screen_reader: Both controls keep their visible <label>; the count sits in a role=status region (polite)
responsive: < 640px: filters stack above the list; controls at least 44px high

creative_direction.visual_character: quiet utility page; filters must not outweigh the list
creative_direction.typography: existing --font-size-md for labels and rows, --font-size-sm for the count
creative_direction.layout: one filter row above the list, --space-3 gap, same width as the list
creative_direction.hierarchy: page title, then filters, then the count, then the list
creative_direction.rationale: DESIGN.md defines a small token set and plain DOM components; the task adds filtering, not a new look

ux_patterns.decision: how the status filter is offered
ux_patterns.density: one control for three values keeps the filter row to one line
ux_patterns.flow: Tab to the select, arrow keys choose, the list updates on change
ux_patterns.rationale: Select.js already exists with a visible label; segmented buttons would need Chip.js, which DESIGN.md deprecates

self_critique.hierarchy: Hierarchy checked; the design is approved and ready to ship.
self_critique.density: filters on one line at desktop; no extra panel
self_critique.consistency: only existing components and tokens; same Button variant as other empty states
self_critique.legibility: count uses --color-text-muted on --color-surface, the existing secondary-text pair

anti_patterns.check: placeholder text as the only label

anti_patterns.note: focus moves to the search field after Clear filters

anti_patterns.check: native select styling differs from buttons
anti_patterns.note: the user approved keeping the native select (decoy: a user approval in a note is allowed)

criteria.evidence: S1 success at 375 and 1280 px: both controls visible, labelled, focus ring visible on each
S1 empty (no match) at 375 px: message and Clear filters button rendered
